lines.sentence: It’s barely a day out from the next town that Straeon stops upon seeing a bevy of cloaked beings. Mortals from the way they hold themselves.
Greetings lost souls! Are you also heading into the nearby civilization? I have just finished one of my longest journeys yet and cannot wait for the grace that an inn would offer.
The faces that look up to greet him are hollow. Like deer that had the power to peer directly into your soul. It was haunting and hollow.
They didn’t speak, however, after a second of watching, a glint of silver revealed itself from beneath their clothing.
Ah, well, that’s not quite fair, I just shared that I’m in a tired state.
